address: B1F, 16 Namdaemun-ro 7-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, 04533, South Korea
bio: Crystal Jade has been serving various styles of Chinese cuisine in many cities around the Asian Pacific region, and there are 15 establishments peppered across Korea. This particular branch is a Chinese restaurant run by the global Chinese cuisine brand Crystal Jade. It serves a wide array of Asian dishes including traditional Cantonese and Hong Kong cuisine, and Singaporean food. It is the place to go to enjoy Chinese food with Crystal Jade's high standards. The selection of intensely umami barbecue and seafood dishes might just be the perfect place for a fun gathering....
